positions.name: NativePipelineMaxim
positions.frame: how are contract terms rendered when the speaker performs them as terse technical maxims in native pipeline vocabulary?
positions.why: All three expressions perform the async remember contract's design rules using domain-native vocabulary — receipt, polling, cursor, piggybacked, blocking call, lost work — with no accessibility hedge or outsider glossing. The set holds a conviction gradient: src-1 performs ratification as a settled decision while src-2 and src-3 state supporting claims, but the register signature is coherent across all three, making the shared technical-maxim rendering the spanning directional read.
